Best Bánh Mi in Hanoi
Sep 2026 • Couples
We were lucky enough to stay next door to Báhn MiOi. We had been in Hanoi for two weeks at that time. We had it for breakfast everyday whoever we were in the city but the best place we found in all of Hanoi was here. We liked the traditional, the chicken and I really loved the vegan mushroom. The bread was always fresh in the morning when we came down for our breakfast. The owner and the staff were awesome and welcoming with genuine warmth and smile. We will coming here and will visit on our next trip for sure.
